findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the read check
findings.body: When the user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. Callers relying on this authorization predicate can therefore expose documents across tenant boundaries; retain the tenant equality check or an equivalent authorization rule.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document-read authorization check
findings.body:
Any call with differing tenant IDs, such as `canReadDocument("tenant-a", "tenant-b")`, now returns `true`. Callers relying on this exported authorization predicate will permit cross-tenant document access, exposing tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
